Name: Decentered Tortilla
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Did the Recenter Tortilla mod convince you that you had a problem when you've never had an issue before? Did you believe that you really needed the tortilla recentered? Do you now regret downloading the Recenter Tortilla mod?

Well do I have the mod for you!

Decenter Tortilla is a simple mod that reverts the ﻿abhorrent change made by Recenter Tortilla. Now your tortilla can be decentered once again, just how ConcernedApe intended.
